title: 第112章 虚伪的借口
content_zh:
话音刚落，格拉维克周身的金色宇宙能量骤然暴涨，整个人化作一颗拖着尾焰的流星，朝着李艾猛冲而去。

【Plasma！】

李艾一转驱动器里的等离子胶囊，黄金雷电狂暴程度再上一层楼，他纵身一跃，正面迎上了格拉维克的撞击。

雷电与流光轰然相撞，毁灭性的冲击波向四周扩散，神盾

陈肖然摇了摇头，不再多想。反正订婚的事已经决定了，接下来就等着舞会开启就行。

随着这爆炸声，有声音似天雷从远处传来，紧接着一道虹光急射而至，化做成一金甲大汉，看着向罡天两人，便是一剑斩落。

听到那脚步声，陈肖然将手中遥控器放下，微微侧过脸，一侧过脸，他正好对上庄淑华出神的视线。庄淑华脸颊一红，赶忙移开视线。

“恐怕不止如此吧，你毕竟是光明神的遗蜕，若不是做得过了，为何会被这般对待！”典风全然不信，绝不会认为，它只是过于高傲的缘故。

若是有人在此，定然能发现，周边空气似乎随着罗昊拳势而动，以其为中心，形成一股低气压风暴。

以自己如今天元境中期的修为，绝对不可能抗衡得了这头天元境后期的炽火血蝠的。

我的忧伤轻易戳穿他的谎言、只能遭到他的反感，我没有傻到那种地步。

袁晓芸没听到周晓怜的回话，她下意识回头看了周晓怜一眼，只见周晓怜正抿着‘唇’，看着前方离开的方向，美目内泛着一丝担忧。

霎时间，董如浑身都感觉温暖起来，眼里也有了光彩，一股力量冥冥中油然而生，紧接着身心一松，一直以来惶恐不安的内心终于放下，让她有一瞬间的晕眩，但她还是撑住了。

天目四人，俱都是八品圣祖，要想擒拿他们可不是容易的事。一旦惊动其他的人，那可是极其凶险的。

东方卫视里在播放着关于东洋的这条消息，毕竟是一衣带水的邻国，中国还是有很多人挺在乎东洋的新闻的。

对于杜远，陆野的印象还是不错的，所以自是知无不言。草心的炼制，其实本也没有什么复杂的，只要理解了其中的五行相辅，自然也就会明白了。杜远听陆野解释一番，才从之前的只是死记步骤的炼制中顿悟。

而孝陵周围筑有城墙，距离南京东侧仅七里左右，清军自城中冲出，须臾便能赶至此处增援。故而他还让余新陈兵南京东侧，仔细做了准备，这才开始攻取孝陵。

看着黄河淤积如此严重，哪怕心里早做准备的林晧然亦是暗叹一声，很想将朝廷的大佬都拉过来瞧上一瞧，问他们于心何忍？

高岳因为要处理公司的业务纠纷，以前跟他打过很多次交道，也算是好朋友了。

“哈哈哈，到时候我妈妈看见你和我，不知道会有什么样的表情呢！”肖潇不知道想到了什么，她的脸上荡漾出一抹羞红的笑容。

在这里，改造完成后耳目一新的大飞机停在这里，散发着迷人的光芒。

又稍微巩固了一下修为，陆野才发现天色竟然已经黑透了。车里没有叶清的身影，推门下车，看到坐在河岸边发呆的叶清，陆野走了过去，在叶清身边坐下。

“我！我！还有我，顺便也带上我！”听到要逃出黑狱，一直在旁倾听的柳士气，也是连忙跟着嚷嚷。

As soon as he finished speaking, the golden cosmic energy around Gravek suddenly surged, and his entire body turned into a meteor trailing flames, rushing towards Li Ai.

【Plasma!】

Li Ai turned the plasma capsule in the driver, and the golden thunder and lightning became more violent. He jumped up and met Gravik's impact head-on.

Thunder and lightning collided with each other, and the devastating shock wave spread to all directions. Aegis

Chen Xiaoran shook his head and stopped thinking about it.Anyway, the engagement has been decided, and all we have to do is wait for the dance to start.

Following the explosion, there was a sound like thunder from the distance, and then a rainbow light shot out, turning into a big man in golden armor. He looked at Xiang Gangtian and the two of them and slashed them down with a sword.

Hearing the footsteps, Chen Xiaoran put down the remote control in his hand and turned his face slightly to one side. He happened to meet Zhuang Shuhua's distracted gaze.Zhuang Shuhua's cheeks turned red and she quickly looked away.

"I'm afraid it's more than that. After all, you are a descendant of the God of Light. If you hadn't gone too far, why would you have been treated like this!" Dianfeng didn't believe it at all, and would never think that it was just because of being too arrogant.

If someone were here, they would definitely notice that the surrounding air seemed to move with Luo Hao's fist, forming a low-pressure storm centered on it.

With my current cultivation level in the middle Tianyuan realm, it is absolutely impossible to compete with this blazing blood bat in the late Tianyuan realm.

My sadness easily exposes his lies, only to be resented by him. I am not that stupid.

Yuan Xiaoyun didn't hear Zhou Xiaolian's reply. She subconsciously turned back and glanced at Zhou Xiaolian. She saw Zhou Xiaolian pursed her lips and looked in the direction of departure, with a trace of worry in her beautiful eyes.

In an instant, Dong Ru felt warm all over, and there was light in her eyes. A force suddenly emerged, and then her body and mind relaxed. The fear and anxiety she had been feeling finally let go, which made her dizzy for a moment, but she still held on.

The four Tianmu people are all eighth-grade saint ancestors. It is not easy to capture them.Once other people are alerted, it is extremely dangerous.

Dragon TV is broadcasting this news about Japan. After all, it is a neighboring country separated by a strip of water. There are still many people in China who care about news about Japan.

Lu Ye had a good impression of Du Yuan, so he knew everything he knew.The refining of grass heart is actually not complicated at all. As long as you understand the complementarity of the five elements, you will naturally understand it.After listening to Lu Ye's explanation, Du Yuan had an epiphany from the previous refining process of just memorizing the steps.

There was a city wall built around Xiaoling Mausoleum, which was only about seven miles east of Nanjing. The Qing army rushed out of the city and could arrive here for reinforcements in a short time.Therefore, he also asked Yu Xin and Chen to send troops to the east of Nanjing. After careful preparation, he began to capture Xiaoling.

Seeing how serious the siltation of the Yellow River was, Lin Haoran sighed secretly even though he had been prepared for it. He wanted to bring all the big shots in the court over to take a look and ask them how they could tolerate it?

Because Gao Yue had to deal with the company's business disputes, he had dealt with him many times before, and he was considered a good friend.

"Hahaha, I wonder what kind of expression my mother will have when she sees you and me!" Xiao Xiao didn't know what she thought of, and a blushing smile appeared on her face.

Here, the large aircraft that looked brand new after the renovation was parked here, exuding a charming light.

After consolidating his cultivation a little more, Lu Ye realized that the sky was already completely dark.There was no sign of Ye Qing in the car. He opened the door and got out of the car. Seeing Ye Qing sitting in a daze on the bank of the river, Lu Ye walked over and sat down next to Ye Qing.

"Me! Me! And me, take me with you too!" Liu Shiqi, who had been listening to the news that he was about to escape from the prison, quickly followed suit.
